errors.text: The proposed athermal nucleation mechanism conflicts with the reported temperature dependence, which attributes easier nucleation and lower yield strength to thermally enhanced atomic motion.

The orientation explanation is mechanically inconsistent: if the <-111>/<11-1> orientation truly maximized the Schmid factor at a common critical resolved shear stress, it should generally yield at a lower, not higher, applied tensile stress.

Nucleation exclusively at deliberately controlled vacancy clusters is stronger than the target evidence, which identifies vacancy clusters or locally disordered atoms as initiation sites without establishing exclusivity.
